generate_android_bp_and_mk: run generate_build_files.py with android to produce sources.bp and sources.mk for Android build
generate_bazel_build_files: run generate_build_files.py with bazel to produce BUILD.generated.bzl and BUILD.generated_tests.bzl files
generate_gn_build_files: run generate_build_files.py with gn to produce BUILD.generated.gni and BUILD.generated_tests.gni files
generate_gyp_build_files: run generate_build_files.py with gyp to produce boringssl.gypi for GYP-based builds
generate_eureka_mk: run generate_build_files.py with eureka to produce eureka.mk for the Eureka Trusty build
